text: void DOES consume hexa — 4 files, 540 lines: project.hexa (hexa project root marker · struct+array literal returned), install.hexa (256 lines · the `hx install void` production hook per CLAUDE.md — zig build -> /Applications/Void.app -> bin shim), tool/build_iconset.hexa (189), tool/install-to-applications.hexa (60). The previous entry claimed "void는 현재 Zig 터미널(hexa 비소비)이라 즉시 적용 대상 아님 / 향후 hexa 도입 시" — FALSE on the premise, so a future session could skip the check believing void is a non-consumer. commons hexa-lang-model applies NOW. Audited this session against all four dont clauses, verified by grep on the real files (comments stripped): (1) manual free/GC on arena values — none; (2) fn-arena composite assigned to a module-global (the arena-escape hazard) — structurally impossible: there is not a single column-0 let/var/global in any of the 4 files, every `let` is fn-local (install.hexa 17/22/27 are indented fn bodies, a false positive from a sloppy ^\\s*let regex I corrected); (3) farr_* device handles — unused, so no leak surface; (4) @own — unused, i.e. the default arena path. project.hexa returns a ProjectMeta{...} composite with [string] array literals from project_meta(), which is exactly the SSOT §1.1 sanctioned pattern (return value auto-heapified by __hexa_fn_arena_return, arena reclaimed at scope_pop) — compliant, no manual free wanted. VERDICT: 0 violations, no code change needed — but for the REASON "audited and compliant", not "not a consumer". Re-audit if void gains module-level state or GPU farr_* handles. Side note (not a void bug, do not chase): project.hexa hexa_lang points at the dead /Users/ghost/Dev/hexa-lang, but every sibling incl. hexa-lang itself carries the same fossil and `hexa` resolves via the HEXA_LANG env var / repo root, not this field — decorative, ecosystem-wide.
